qemu.title: Milibot's QEMU was not found
qemu.description: Milibot ships with QEMU, which runs the bots' virtual machine, but it is missing from this installation. Reinstall Milibot, then check again.
qemu.stillMissing: Still not found. Reinstall Milibot, then check again.

kvm.noDeviceTitle: No KVM acceleration: the machine will be slow
kvm.noDevice: /dev/kvm was not found. Without it the machine runs emulated (TCG), much slower. Turn on virtualization (Intel VT-x or AMD-V) in the computer's firmware and check that the kvm module is loaded. You can continue anyway.
kvm.noPermission: Your user cannot open /dev/kvm. Join the kvm group with the command below, then log out and back in. Without it the machine runs emulated, much slower.
kvm.relogin: Your user is already in the kvm group, but this session started before that. Log out and back in so the machine can use KVM.

feature_disabled.title: Turn on Windows Hypervisor Platform
feature_disabled.body: Without it, the machine runs emulated (TCG), much slower. Turn it on in "Turn Windows features on or off" (optionalfeatures) or run this command in PowerShell as administrator:

reboot_pending.title: Restart Windows to finish
reboot_pending.body: Windows Hypervisor Platform is already on, but it only starts working after the computer restarts. Restart and come back here.

virtualization_disabled.title: Virtualization is off on this computer
virtualization_disabled.body: Virtualization is turned off in the firmware. Turn on Intel VT-x or AMD-V (SVM) in the computer's BIOS/UEFI and restart. Without it, the machine runs emulated, much slower. You can continue anyway.

unavailable.title: No WHPX acceleration: the machine will be slow
unavailable.body: Windows Hypervisor Platform is not available, so the machine runs emulated (TCG), much slower. Turn the feature on in "Turn Windows features on or off" (optionalfeatures) or run this command in PowerShell as administrator:
unavailable.note: Then restart the computer. If that does not help, check that virtualization (Intel VT-x or AMD-V) is on in the BIOS/UEFI.

whpx.restartNote: Then restart the computer and check again. You can continue without it, with a slower machine.
